summary:
Plan written for w96 (migration-tools r7, r18, r25, r26). The stage-2 question is settled by the person's answer (Reading A).
The accepted scenarios pass today and must stay green. Each fix (N4, N5, N6, N8, F7, F8, F9, F12) gets a test in tests/scripts/.
F7: `migrate status --hook` exits 0 and prints one line: the version file holds no version, what it holds, and to tell the person (answer 2026-10-23).
`migrate status` and `migrate upgrade` refuse a version that is not a version on stderr, exit 1, change nothing (r18, r7).
N5 rewrites only name values; #r<n> tokens and comments are left (r26). N4 names the field and removes repeated lines (r7).
F8 is refused through the plan's failures, only when a work-item needs the id (r7, r26). F9 breaks ties by initiative name (r25).
The symbolic-link version-file defect is out of scope. No existing test breaks (checked by search; no coverage map).
